75017fd4e5cce150.description: About the Role Boston Consulting Group (BCG) is seeking a Senior Analyst, BCG Vantage M&A and Financial Modelling, to join its Transactions & Integrations (TI) team, part of the Corporate Finance and Strategy (CFS) practice. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. The Senior Analyst will contribute to a growing global team, delivering value to clients through expertise and institutionalized knowledge assets related to Mergers & Acquisitions, Post-Merger Integration (PMI), and Carve-out topics. The Transactions & Integrations Practice The Transactions & Integrations (TI) business is a significant and rapidly expanding practice within BCG, comprising over 300 M&A, transactions, and post-merger integration professionals globally. The practice supports both corporate and private equity clients in executing deals efficiently and maximizing value creation. Over the past decade, BCG has supported more than 7,000 transactions with a market value exceeding $5 trillion. The practice provides end-to-end transaction excellence, including strategic decision-making in M&A, preparing and executing divestitures and joint ventures, supporting IPOs and spinoffs, and developing strategies for post-merger integration. Key Responsibilities Contribute to cases and proposals by providing relevant analysis and insights to support client impact. Travel occasionally to serve clients onsite during staffing assignments to understand requirements and design solutions. Support commercialization efforts for the topic/sector by contributing analysis and insights to proposals, client workshops, and marketing materials, in conjunction with business leaders. Contribute to the development of intellectual property and assets for the business. Assist in onboarding and training junior colleagues based on topic/sector expertise. Required Skills and Experience Proven ability to build and create detailed business plans and financial models for M&A, divestitures, other corporate transactions, and investment cases. Understanding of the buy-side and sell-side M&A process, including key steps, timelines, and documentation. Capability to apply Transaction and Corporate Finance expertise when contributing to product/tool development and deployment, considering diverse client contexts. Experience working collaboratively and effectively in virtual group dynamics, proficient in agile methodologies. Strong communication skills for interacting with senior stakeholders in a credible, structured, and confident manner. Aptitude for framing, structuring, and sharing intellectual property, with clear and concise writing abilities. Ability to work creatively and analytically in a time-limited, problem-solving environment. Flexibility, a curious and creative mindset, openness to new ideas, and the ability to propose innovative solutions. Demonstrated ability to navigate complexity and ambiguity. Team Collaboration As a Senior Analyst, you will collaborate with global topic leads and colleagues across BCG to provide expertise and capabilities to internal and external clients. The Transactions & Integrations Vantage Team, comprising over 20 analysts globally, is deeply involved in client work and the development of publications, intellectual property, and tools for the practice area. Vantage Team members are functional and/or industry experts who leverage deep domain knowledge to generate insights for case teams and clients. They are affiliated with BCG Practice Areas, aligned with strategic agendas, and responsible for building and deploying leading-edge IP data tools and assets to deliver insights. Team members have opportunities to be staffed on cases, co-create insights with case teams and clients through expert perspectives on industry trends, deliver proprietary data or tools, and conduct complex research and analysis of market information. They also support business development, proposals, and the codification of knowledge to enhance BCG's client value delivery.

7504e5893dfc59a2.description: About the Role United Group is seeking a Process Engineer to join their team in Yanbu Al Sinaiyah, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves supporting the development, optimization, and troubleshooting of plant processes to ensure safe, efficient, and reliable production. The role focuses on monitoring process performance, investigating operational issues, and providing technical support to plant operators and engineering teams. Role Overview The Process Engineer is responsible for driving improvements in production, efficiency, reliability, and quality. This involves a range of activities from process design and optimization to performance monitoring, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis. The successful candidate will collaborate with various teams to resolve operational issues and support continuous improvement initiatives within the plant. Key Accountabilities Develop, review, and optimize process operating procedures, process designs, and engineering calculations. Identify opportunities to enhance production, efficiency, reliability, and product quality. Support the implementation of process improvements and engineering changes across the plant. Monitor plant and process performance against targets, identifying deviations and areas for improvement. Troubleshoot process deviations, equipment performance issues, and operational problems. Support shutdown, startup, and commissioning activities as required. Conduct root-cause analysis of process and equipment issues. Recommend and implement practical corrective and preventive actions. Maintain records of incidents, corrective actions, and lessons learned to support continuous improvement. Technical Support and Collaboration Provide technical support and guidance to plant operators and engineering teams. Collaborate with Maintenance, Quality, and Production teams to resolve operational issues. Support training of plant personnel on process procedures and best practices. The role requires a strong understanding of plant processes, operational troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis methodologies. Location This position is based in Yanbu Al Sinaiyah, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia, serving the Yanbu and Medina regions.

757b41d9220d3d73.description: About Tata Consultancy Services Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is an IT services, consulting, and business solutions organization with over 50 years of experience partnering with global businesses in their transformation journeys. TCS offers a consulting-led, cognitive-powered, integrated portfolio of business, technology, and engineering services and solutions. The company operates through its Location Independent Agile™ delivery model, recognized for excellence in software development. As part of the Tata group, India's largest multinational business group, TCS employs over 616,171 consultants from 157 nationalities across 53 countries. The Role of IT Chargeback Manager TCS is seeking an IT Chargeback Manager to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves overseeing the complete lifecycle of dispute management, ensuring adherence to regulatory standards and scheme timelines, and driving operational efficiencies. The manager will be responsible for complex case resolution, fraud trend identification, and maintaining robust controls within the chargeback process. Key Responsibilities Oversee the full dispute lifecycle, including intake, investigation, chargeback filing, representment, pre-arbitration, and arbitration. Ensure all disputes are raised and responded to within scheme timelines and regulatory Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Review complex and high-value cases, making final decisions on escalations. Manage the resolution of fraud, authorization, processing error, and consumer dispute reason codes. Ensure adherence to Visa, Mastercard, and mada operating rules, as well as SAMA consumer protection and card regulations. Maintain controls, procedures, and audit evidence; support internal audit, compliance, and regulatory reviews. Identify fraud trends, merchant abuse, and friendly-fraud patterns, and recommend mitigating actions. Monitor chargeback ratios, recovery rates, write-offs, and scheme fees/penalties. Manage reconciliation of dispute-related settlements and ensure accurate accounting of recoveries and losses. Produce Management Information (MI) and dashboards for senior management and risk committees. Liaise with card schemes, processors, merchants, fraud, customer service, legal, and finance teams. Manage relationships with third-party vendors and dispute-management platforms. Drive automation, process improvement, and system enhancements to reduce manual effort and turnaround time. Handle customer and regulator complaints related to disputes. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a dynamic environment, collaborating with various internal and external stakeholders to manage and optimize chargeback processes.

755aec6ab656e6b6.description: About CEER CEER is seeking an Assistant Manager Customer Care Charging to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Direct the operation and maintenance of potable water supply, storage, pumping, and distribution assets. 75b3f31f3f1f24b1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مجمع الرحمه الطبي عن مساعد طبيب أسنان للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى دعم طبيب الأسنان في مهامه اليومية، وضمان سير العمل بكفاءة في العيادة. يتضمن العمل تحضير المواد والأدوات، ومساعدة المرضى، والحفاظ على نظافة وتعقيم المعدات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال المرضى وإجلاسهم على كرسي طب الأسنان، وتوثيق بياناتهم الشخصية في ملفاتهم. تنظيف وتطهير وتعقيم الأجهزة والأدوات المستخدمة في عيادة الأسنان بشكل دوري. تفقد وتشغيل كرسي الأسنان والتأكد من جاهزيته للاستخدام. تحضير المواد السنية المطلوبة وخلط الحشوات المؤقتة والدائمة، بالإضافة إلى خلط المواد العازلة. مساعدة طبيب الأسنان أثناء الإجراءات العلاجية، ومناولته الأدوات والمواد اللازمة، وسحب اللعاب. تفقد أدوات ومعدات العمل، وتنظيفها، وتخزين مواد الأسنان وفقًا لظروف التخزين المناسبة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال مساعد طبيب الأسنان. القدرة على تحضير المواد السنية وخلط الحشوات. معرفة جيدة بتفقد الأجهزة والمعدات والأدوات المستخدمة وخدمتها وتخزينها. بيئة العمل يعمل مساعد طبيب الأسنان ضمن فريق شركة مجمع الرحمه الطبي في مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في العيادة لدعم العمليات اليومية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

75cb9b623505f0ec.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المعمر لأنظمة المعلومات عن أخصائي تحول رقمي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى قيادة مبادرات التحول الرقمي من خلال تحليل البيانات وتطوير العمليات، مما يضمن تحقيق الأهداف الاستراتيجية للشركة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد مصادر المعلومات والبيانات اللازمة لإعداد تحليلات واختبارات التحول الرقمي. اختيار أفضل الطرق والأدوات والأساليب لجمع البيانات وتنظيمها وتحليلها بفعالية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بمجال التحول الرقمي، وعرضها وحفظها بشكل منظم. دراسة وتحليل الخطط المعدة وتفصيلها إلى عمليات منظمة وقابلة للتنفيذ. تنظيم الأنشطة ومسار سير المعلومات لضمان استهدافها للخدمة أو المنتج المطلوب. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال التحول الرقمي أو ما يعادله. فهم عميق لمنهجيات وأدوات تحليل البيانات والتحول الرقمي. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومقره في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تركز على الابتكار والتطوير المستمر في أنظمة المعلومات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

75f4f532c87ad992.description: About the Role Matar Al Baqmi Holding Company is seeking a Dispatcher - Supply Chain to join their team. This full-time role focuses on supporting logistics and delivery operations within the Supply Chain department. The Dispatcher will be responsible for coordinating daily deliveries and ensuring efficient truck utilization, timely deliveries, and clear communication among all stakeholders. Role Overview The primary objective of this position is to serve as a central coordination point, managing interactions between customers, drivers, dispatchers, and logistics personnel. Key responsibilities include monitoring vehicle movements, confirming customer readiness for deliveries, managing exceptions, and contributing to the continuous improvement of logistics performance. Key Responsibilities Monitor daily truck movements using GPS tracking systems, including departures, arrivals, unloading, and returns. Identify and address delayed, stationary, or route-deviating vehicles, following up with drivers on operational issues. Escalate significant delays, breakdowns, or route problems to relevant stakeholders. Track delivery trips against agreed turnaround times and maintain records of delays and recurring issues. Analyze delay trends and recommend corrective actions to improve fleet utilization. Contact customers prior to dispatch to confirm delivery readiness, verifying storage and silo capacity. Manage delivery schedules and postponement requests, communicating customer requirements and restrictions to logistics teams. Prevent unnecessary dispatches to customers unable to receive deliveries. Serve as the primary coordination point, keeping customers informed of schedules and significant delays. Communicate customer instructions and delivery requirements to drivers and assist in resolving delivery-related concerns. Support the execution of daily dispatch and delivery plans, coordinating truck availability with schedules. Follow up on delayed, postponed, and rescheduled deliveries, supporting optimization of truck allocation. Coordinate with Operations, Sales, Maintenance, and third-party logistics providers regarding delivery issues. Ensure accurate maintenance of delivery documentation and trip records. Proactively identify issues affecting delivery performance, such as vehicle breakdowns, unloading delays, storage limitations, and driver availability. Take immediate action to minimize disruption and escalate unresolved issues to the Logistics Supervisor or Manager. Maintain logs of exceptions, delays, and corrective actions. Prepare daily and weekly logistics reports covering planned versus completed deliveries, truck turnaround times, delayed deliveries, customer-related waiting and unloading delays, postponed or cancelled deliveries, truck utilization, and operational exceptions. Identify recurring issues and provide data-driven recommendations for improvement. Work Type This is a full-time position within Matar Al Baqmi Holding Company. Application Process Candidates interested in this Dispatcher - Supply Chain role are encouraged to apply.

75582887d49ddfa9.company_name: شركة فواز عبدالعزيز الحكير وشركاه التجارية
75582887d49ddfa9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة فواز عبدالعزيز الحكير وشركاه التجارية عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات من خلال تقديم المنتجات والخدمات بفعالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى مندوب المبيعات مسؤولية إدارة دورة المبيعات الكاملة، بدءاً من جمع البيانات وصولاً إلى تحصيل الديون. تشمل المهام الأساسية ما يلي: جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات (السلع والخدمات) لضمان فهم شامل للعروض. بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، مع توثيق بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء أو زيارتهم لترويج المنتجات وتقديم عروض البيع، مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المخولة، وإتمام عملية البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. تحصيل ديون العملاء وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، ثم توريدها إلى الدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات نبحث عن مرشح يمتلك المؤهلات التالية: خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو دور ذي صلة. القدرة على جمع وتحليل البيانات المتعلقة بالمنتجات والعملاء. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في المدينة المنورة، ويتطلب التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء والعمل ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي.

757e2591bb2a8126.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مركز اقدامي الرياضي عن بائع للانضمام إلى فريقه في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تقديم مجموعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء، مع توفير معلومات دقيقة حول المنتجات واستخداماتها وأسعارها. يتولى البائع أيضاً مسؤولية عمليات الدفع وإدارة المخزون لضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة متنوعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء. توفير معلومات شاملة للعملاء حول المنتجات، بما في ذلك استخداماتها وأسعارها. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بانتظام والحفاظ على ترتيب المتجر. إصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات الجديدة والتعامل مع المنتجات الواردة. إدارة عمليات الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من العملاء. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات وفقاً للسياسات المتبعة في المركز. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء بفعالية وتقديم خدمة ممتازة. مهارات جيدة في التواصل والعرض. متطلبات العمل القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات المركز. المرونة في التعامل مع مهام متعددة. بيئة العمل يقع هذا الدور في مدينة مكة المكرمة، ويوفر بيئة عمل ديناميكية ضمن مركز اقدامي الرياضي. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء والعمل ضمن فريق لضمان تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتقديم أفضل تجربة للعملاء. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل في قطاع البيع بالتجزئة، حيث يمكن للمرشحين الجدد اكتساب خبرة قيمة وتطوير مهاراتهم في خدمة العملاء وإدارة المبيعات. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب في الوقت الحالي.

75988f82d1c2dee3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ميسان لتقنية المعلومات عن أخصائي خدمة عملاء للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتحسين جودة خدمة العملاء، وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء، والمساهمة في صياغة الإجراءات والأدلة لضمان رضا العملاء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الدراسات والتحاليل المتخصصة لوضع وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية ومعايير الجودة لخدمة العملاء، بالتنسيق مع إدارة الجودة، ومتابعتها لضمان سير العمل. المشاركة في وضع وتحديث إجراءات وأدلة خدمة العملاء، بما في ذلك تفاصيل الاتصال بهم واستلام طلباتهم واستفساراتهم والرد عليها بفعالية وكفاءة، والتنسيق مع الإدارات المعنية. تطوير برامج ومبادرات تهدف إلى تجاوز توقعات واحتياجات العملاء من حيث جودة ومهنية أنظمة خدمة العملاء، لبناء نموذج متكامل للخدمة. تحليل المعلومات والبيانات لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف في أنظمة خدمة العملاء، وتحليل نتائج تقييم رضا العملاء، وتحديد الأنماط المتكررة للشكاوى والثغرات، ووضع خطط لمعالجتها. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بخدمة العملاء، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال خدمة العملاء أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على وضع وتحديد مؤشرات ومعايير الأداء والجودة. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف في أنظمة خدمة العملاء. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة، كتابية وشفوية. القدرة على إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة. مهارات حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرار. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومقره في الرياض. سيعمل أخصائي خدمة العملاء ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تعزيز جودة الخدمات المقدمة للعملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف.

75a96b24766ac0a5.company_name: Mohammad Al Habib Real Estate Co.
75a96b24766ac0a5.description: About Bechtel Corporation and the Jubail Project Bechtel Corporation has been instrumental in the development of Jubail, one of the largest civil engineering projects in modern times, located in the Eastern Province of Saudi Arabia. Since the mid-1970s, Bechtel has managed this significant project, which continues to expand. Saudi Arabian Bechtel Company (SABCO) operates as the Management Services Contractor for the Royal Commission, overseeing engineering, procurement, and construction. The scope includes managing design submissions and supervising construction work by local contractors in Jubail and Ras Al-Khair Industrial Cities. The contract was renewed in June 2026 for another five years, focusing on new residential communities, infrastructure, and various public facilities. Role Summary: Area Safety Engineer The Area Safety Engineer reports to the Lead Safety Engineer or the Project ESH Manager. This full-time role is based in Al Jubail and involves conducting project-wide Environmental, Safety, and Health (ES&H) initiatives and providing essential technical support across various construction activities. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Conduct project-wide ES&H initiatives, including vehicle inspection campaigns, focused assessments of contract work sites (*, work at height, chemical storage, traffic management, environmental inspections, scaffolding, PPE, excavations). Provide technical support and review client contractor method statements and risk assessments. Offer safety technical support and assistance to contract projects during site visits. Participate in meetings with customers, project construction colleagues, and client contractors/subcontractors to advise on safety requirements. Provide recommendations and input for revising safety procedures, work processes, and other improvement measures. Conduct safety inspections/assessments of project construction activities to monitor compliance with applicable safety and health requirements, contractual commitments, permits, and the project’s ES&H Manual. Produce detailed reports on corrective actions. Develop and deliver training presentations as required. Undertake additional duties as assigned by the Lead Safety Engineer and Project ESH Manager. Qualifications and Experience College/University degree in a subject relevant to Management of ESH from an accredited institution. Minimum of 5 years of relevant work experience in the construction industry or related fields, demonstrating a thorough understanding of the role requirements. Demonstrated experience in implementing all aspects of Construction ESH Management. Experience in conducting safety inspections/assessments of project construction activities to monitor compliance with ES&H requirements. NEBOSH / International General Certification preferred, or a similar internationally recognized ESH certification. Experience working with construction contractors to ensure ESH standards are understood and complied with. Knowledge of hazardous materials, physical risk exposures, Personal Protective Equipment standards, and People Based Safety (behavioral safety) processes and procedures. Experience in managing and/or providing technical oversight of safety and/or health subcontractors or consultants. Knowledge of engineering and construction systems, methods, and work processes. Required Skills Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to explain ESH-related work processes and standards to contractors. Ability to prepare ESH training presentations and deliver training sessions effectively. Capability to work within a culturally diverse organization, recognizing and respecting differences. Self-motivated with good leadership skills and the ability to influence without direct authority. Demonstrated ability to influence key stakeholders in critical decision-making. Ability to work effectively within an integrated RC/Bechtel team across multiple levels, from working staff to Project Manager. Effective communication skills for delivering presentations to diverse groups, from senior managers to field workers, ensuring key messages are received. Knowledge of national and international environmental laws/regulations, industry standards for environmental compliance, and best management practices for minimizing environmental impacts during project execution. Knowledge of construction planning and execution. Experience in environmental monitoring and compliance inspection during construction. Knowledge of hazardous materials and waste management, erosion and sediment control methods, and restoration techniques. 75791303c6b31d10.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة إدارة والإشراف على أنشطة الصيانة الكهربائية ضمن مشروع إدارة المرافق (FM)، بهدف ضمان التشغيل الآمن والموثوق لأنظمة التوزيع الكهربائية، والإضاءة، ومعدات الطاقة، والمولدات، وأنظمة UPS، بالإضافة إلى الأصول الكهربائية المرتبطة بها من خلال الصيانة الوقائية والتصحيحية الفعالة. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على أنشطة الصيانة الكهربائية عبر منشآت المشروع والمباني. تطوير ومراقبة خطط الصيانة الوقائية والتصحيحية للأصول الكهربائية. مراقبة تشغيل لوحات التوزيع الكهربائية، المحولات، المولدات، أنظمة UPS، وأنظمة الإضاءة. مراجعة الرسومات الكهربائية، والمخططات ذات الخط الواحد، والمواصفات الفنية. التحقيق في الأعطال الكهربائية والتوصية بالإجراءات التصحيحية المناسبة. ضمان الامتثال للأنظمة الكهربائية والمعايير وإجراءات السلامة المعمول بها. التنسيق مع فرق العمليات لتخطيط عمليات الإغلاق، والعزل، وأنشطة الصيانة. مراقبة استهلاك الطاقة الكهربائية وتحديد فرص كفاءة الطاقة. مراجعة أوامر العمل، تقارير الفحص، وسجلات الصيانة الكهربائية. تقديم الإرشاد الفني للمشرفين والفنيين الكهربائيين. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية أو الصيانة الكهربائية. فهم عميق لأنظمة التوزيع الكهربائية، المولدات، أنظمة UPS، وأنظمة الإضاءة. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير الرسومات الكهربائية والمخططات الفنية. معرفة بمعايير السلامة الكهربائية والامتثال للوائح. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الكهربائي بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق متخصص في إدارة المرافق والصيانة. تتطلب الوظيفة الإشراف المباشر على الأنشطة الميدانية لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة وأمان. التقديم للوظيفة ندعو المهندسين الكهربائيين ذوي الخبرة المناسبة للتقديم لهذه الفرصة في شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل بالرياض.

75b91ef493776f85.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سما المنار للمقاولات والتجارة عن مهندس إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في القنفذة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تخطيط المشاريع وتنفيذها ومراقبتها لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة ضمن النطاق الزمني والميزانية المحددين. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع وتنفيذ خطة متكاملة للمشروع، والتحكم في التغييرات، وتحديد نطاق المشروع بدقة من حيث البنود والأزمنة، مع التعرف على الجوانب الفنية المحددة لتنفيذ العمل. تقدير الأوقات والمواعيد النهائية للمشروع، وإعداد الجداول الزمنية باستخدام البرامج والتطبيقات المخصصة لتطوير جداول العمل، وتحديد المهام المجدولة وفترات تنفيذها والموارد المتاحة لكل منها. إدارة التكلفة والموارد المطلوبة لإنجاز المشروع، بما في ذلك تخطيط وإدارة الموارد البشرية والمادية والمعدات والتقنيين، وتقدير التكلفة المتوقعة بالتعاون مع مهندسي التكاليف والمهندسين المعنيين بالتنفيذ ومتابعة الإنفاق. إعداد وتطبيق خطة علاقات مع جميع الأطراف ذات الصلة بالمشروع، وتوفير أساس لتوزيع المعلومات ونشر حالة مراحل المشروع. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إدارة المشاريع أو ما يعادله. القدرة على وضع خطط مشاريع متكاملة والتحكم في التغييرات. إتقان استخدام برامج وتطبيقات إعداد الجداول الزمنية للمشاريع. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والتنظيم. القدرة على إدارة التكاليف والموارد بفعالية. مهارات تواصل قوية لإدارة العلاقات مع الأطراف المعنية. الدقة في إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الفنية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في القنفذة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل المهندس ضمن فريق متخصص في إدارة المشاريع لضمان تنفيذ المشاريع بكفاءة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

75c64dca8d5dbd9c.description: About Lucid Motors Middle East Lucid Motors is dedicated to creating advanced mobility experiences through innovation, driving the world forward. Review electrical schematics, specifications, interface requirements, special characteristics, DFMEA/PFMEA, control plans, work instructions, and test standards for completeness and manufacturing applicability. Coordinate APQP/PPAP and validation of electrical parts and processes, including continuity, insulation resistance, dielectric withstand, grounding, connector engagement, pin integrity, torque, end-of-line functional tests, and diagnostic checks. Define incoming, in-process, control point, and end-of-line inspection and test requirements, and support test equipment qualification, measurement system analysis, calibration, golden samples, limits, and operator training. Preferred Qualifications Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Automotive Engineering, or a related discipline. Practical experience with EV Powertrain electrical systems, electric motors, inverters, power electronics, high-voltage components, harnesses, sensors, controllers, or end-of-line testing. Experience supporting new product launches, greenfield manufacturing, or high-volume production ramp-up. High-voltage training or certification and familiarity with functional safety, configuration control, and vehicle network diagnostics. Exceptional ability to operate at the intersection of technology, design, and executive governance.

75e7bfb2c5cb765d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أفراس للتجارة والمقاولات عن أخصائي تمريض للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم رعاية تمريضية شاملة للمرضى، بدءًا من التقييم ووضع خطط الرعاية وصولاً إلى تنفيذ الإجراءات الطبية ومتابعة الحالة الصحية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقييم الوضع الصحي للمرضى، وجمع البيانات منهم ومن ذويهم، وتوثيقها وتحليلها لتحديد احتياجات الرعاية. إعداد خطط الرعاية التمريضية ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم نتائجها بشكل دوري. أخذ العلامات الحيوية للمرضى وعينات الدم والبول والبراز لإجراء الفحوصات المخبرية وفقًا لتعليمات الطبيب المعالج، ومتابعة إرسالها للمختبر والحصول على النتائج وإعلام الطبيب. إعطاء الأدوية والعقاقير الطبية والمحاليل الوريدية حسب تعليمات الطبيب المعالج. المشاركة الفعالة في عمليات الإنعاش القلبي والرئوي عند الحاجة. توثيق جميع الإجراءات والأنشطة التمريضية المقدمة للمرضى في السجل الطبي الخاص بهم. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال وعمليات التمريض. تطوير الممارسات المهنية يتولى أخصائي التمريض مسؤولية تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر، ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال التمريض والرعاية التمريضية لضمان تقديم أفضل مستويات الخدمة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التمريض. القدرة على تقييم الحالات الصحية بدقة ووضع خطط رعاية فعالة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع المرضى وذويهم والفريق الطبي. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة في تقديم الرعاية التمريضية. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية، وتتطلب التفرغ لتقديم الرعاية التمريضية المطلوبة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم الشروط للتقديم على هذه الفرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة أفراس للتجارة والمقاولات.

7542af44b6783c4c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الصافي دانون عن مدير مبيعات تجزئة للانضمام إلى فريقها في خميس مشيط، عسير. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق عمليات مبيعات التجزئة، والإشراف على مجموعة من متاجر البيع بالتجزئة، بالإضافة إلى إدارة الموازنة والموظفين والأداء العام للمتاجر. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة عمليات البيع بالتجزئة اليومية في المنشأة، وضمان التخصيص الأمثل للموارد. الإشراف على تخطيط شؤون الموظفين وتدريبهم لضمان الكفاءة التشغيلية. مراقبة أداء متاجر البيع بالتجزئة، وإدارة توزيع المكافآت والعلاوات المرتبطة بالأداء. اتخاذ القرارات اللازمة بشأن استبدال المديرين إذا اقتضت الضرورة، وفي التوقيت المناسب. وضع خطط التوسع بناءً على بيانات السوق، مع الأخذ في الاعتبار خيارات التوسع والانكماش المستقبلية. إدارة وحل شكاوى العملاء والنزاعات المحتملة بعد تصعيدها إلى مستوى المدير. ضمان الالتزام بجميع الأنظمة واللوائح والشروط المتعلقة بالعلامات التجارية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال مبيعات التجزئة أو إدارة المتاجر. فهم قوي لعمليات البيع بالتجزئة وإدارة الأداء. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية قوية وقدرة على إدارة وتوجيه الفرق. قدرة على تحليل بيانات السوق ووضع خطط استراتيجية. مهارات ممتازة في حل المشكلات وإدارة النزاعات. القدرة على ضمان الامتثال للوائح والمعايير. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة خميس مشيط بمنطقة عسير، وتتطلب الإشراف المباشر على عمليات المبيعات في متاجر التجزئة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

75623626144c0c3c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة حبر بيننا عن أخصائي تجارة الكترونية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تحليل ومراجعة قوانين التجارة الإلكترونية وتنفيذ العمليات التجارية ذات الصلة، بالإضافة إلى تحديد فرص التطوير والتحسين في هذا المجال. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تحليل بيانات أبحاث السوق لتحديد سلوكيات المستهلكين وتفضيلاتهم وتطبيق أفضل الممارسات. وضع استراتيجيات التجارة الإلكترونية وتنفيذها، وتحليل بيانات الأبحاث السوقية، وتقديم المشورة الاستراتيجية. تصميم وتشغيل حملات التسويق الخاصة وإدارة المنصات والأدوات المتاحة عبر الإنترنت. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتجارة الإلكترونية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة. تحليل التحديات والصعوبات التجارية وحلها منطقياً. تنفيذ العمليات التجارية والإجراءات المصاحبة باستخدام النماذج والوثائق اللازمة وفقاً للسياسات واللوائح المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التجارة الإلكترونية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تحليل بيانات أبحاث السوق وتحديد سلوكيات المستهلكين. مهارات في وضع وتنفيذ استراتيجيات التجارة الإلكترونية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد فرص التطوير والتحسين. القدرة على حل المشكلات والقضايا المتعلقة بالتجارة الإلكترونية. مهارات جيدة في التواصل والعرض. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق عمل شركة حبر بيننا. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المستمر مع العمليات التجارية والإجراءات المصاحبة في مجال التجارة الإلكترونية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

7567f865acbe9cdf.description: About the Role Halian is seeking a Service Representative to provide on-site technical support and maintenance for advanced naval sonar systems. This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, and involves ensuring the operational readiness and performance of towed sonar equipment within a maritime defense environment. The role requires 0-1 years of experience and may include occasional travel or deployment based on operational needs. Key Responsibilities Conduct in-depth fault diagnosis and root-cause analysis for complex sonar system issues. Utilize diagnostic software, test equipment, and maintenance documentation to efficiently identify and resolve technical problems. Provide technical recommendations and support for system performance improvements. Execute planned preventive maintenance activities to maximize equipment availability and operational readiness. Ensure all maintenance activities are completed in accordance with approved maintenance schedules and technical procedures. Support lifecycle management initiatives aimed at extending equipment service life. Required Experience Candidates should possess 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field, demonstrating a foundational understanding of technical support and maintenance principles. The role requires a proactive approach to problem-solving and a commitment to maintaining high operational standards. Work Environment and Location This position is based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. The work involves providing on-site technical support within a maritime defense environment, which may include occasional travel or deployment depending on operational requirements. The role is full-time. Application Information The salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply to join our team at Halian.

75c28958aaa93d1f.description: About the Role International Maritime Industries is seeking an Analyst PIMS to join their team in Ras Tannurah, Eastern region. This full-time role is central to operating and maintaining the Project Information Management System (PIMS) across the entire project lifecycle, from engineering and procurement through to construction and commissioning. The successful candidate will ensure the accurate and efficient management of critical project documentation and facilitate smooth workflow processes. Key Responsibilities Operate and maintain the PIMS platform to support the full project lifecycle, encompassing engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning phases. Ensure proper uploading, classification, and archiving of technical documents, drawings, procedures, and vendor data within PIMS. Monitor workflows for document approvals and ensure timely review cycles are met. Collaborate with document controllers, engineers, project managers, and shipyard contractors. Set up folder structures, user access permissions, and metadata standards within PIMS. Generate reports, track deliverables, and support audits and compliance checks. Conduct training for project personnel on the effective use of the PIMS system. Input, update, and maintain commissioning-related documents in PIMS, including ITRs, MC certificates, NOEs, RFCCs, RFOCs, SATs, and Punch lists. Support the definition of system/subsystem breakdowns, Mechanical Completion certificates, and Inspection Test Records. Enter and validate data for commissioning activities, ensuring accuracy of subsystem details, punch lists, and test results in PIMS. Verify ITRs against field reports, ensuring all engineering items are correctly tagged and linked to systems/subsystems per P&ID drawings. Monitor and update punch item statuses (categories A, B, C), ensuring Category A items are cleared pre-commissioning and Category B items are tracked for post-commissioning resolution. Generate and distribute PIMS R4 reports for commissioning progress, including aggregated values per phase for subsystems and packages. Support the creation of Discipline Mechanical Completion Certificates (MCC) and Livening Up Notices (LUN) or Notice of Energizing (NOE) by ensuring all ITRs and checklists are complete. Prepare summary reports for RFCC and RFOC handovers, highlighting any outstanding punch items. Work closely with commissioning engineers, inspectors, and contractors to collect and verify field data, ensuring PIMS reflects real-time project status. Assist in preparing commissioning procedures by linking predefined PIMS reports to procedure templates. Upload all subsystem documentation breakdowns into PIMS for subsequent administration of the mechanical completion process. Communicate with stakeholders to clarify Punch list resolutions or certification requirements. Maintain traceability of installation and testing data in PIMS, supporting warranty cases and audits. Troubleshoot PIMS-related issues and liaise with the IT support team or vendor. Support the handover of final documentation to the client or operations team upon project completion. Work in conjunction with the production team to effectively achieve project requirements. Qualifications and Experience A Diploma qualification in a relevant discipline is required. Candidates should possess at least 3 years of experience in a shipyard environment, with a preference for experience in new build rigs. The role requires 2-5 years of overall professional experience. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Ras Tannurah, within the Eastern region. The role involves close collaboration with various project teams and external contractors, requiring strong communication and coordination skills.

750d695195d0bd32.description: About the Role Namaa Partners is seeking a Data Analyst to join a full-time, remote position. This role is integral to an operating performance project with a corporate group in Saudi Arabia, based in Dammam, Eastern region, and will extend to subsequent engagements. The position offers a monthly salary in Saudi riyals. Role Context The Data Analyst will be responsible for transforming client data related to sales, costs, staffing, and operations. This involves converting raw data into clean tables, comprehensive dashboards, and concise findings that consultants will present to management. Collaboration with a team operating from Oklahoma City will require some calls at the end of the working day due to time zone differences. Key Responsibilities Collect data extracts from clients' finance, HR, and operations systems, and perform checks for gaps and errors. Clean, join, and reshape data using Excel, SQL, or Python to facilitate comparisons across business units and fiscal years. Develop Power BI dashboards that accurately display agreed-upon performance measures for each engagement. Prepare brief notes to explain changes in numerical data and their underlying reasons. Document all data sources, assumptions, and adjustments to ensure the verifiability of work. Required Qualifications Demonstrated experience in building at least one dashboard, acquired through university projects, internships, or professional work. Work Environment This is a full-time, remote position, allowing candidates to work from home anywhere in Saudi Arabia. The role requires coordination with a team primarily based in Oklahoma City, necessitating flexibility for calls during the later part of the Saudi Arabian workday.

7539c539f8676997.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking a Sales Executive in Jeddah. This full-time role is responsible for driving revenue to achieve the hotel's top-line goals for each represented property by proactively soliciting business across all segments. This includes generating new business from small accounts, identifying new targets, and re-soliciting past business leads. The Sales Executive will focus on the properties' Business Travel (BT) pricing strategy and provide support by coordinating internal mining efforts at assigned hotels. Key Responsibilities Collaborate with the Property Sales Leader (ASL or DOS/DOSM) to identify top accounts, determine account deployment, and coordinate efforts to drive demand. Assist in identifying share shift targets and ensure effective funnel management through available systems. Manage daily Status Change reports to facilitate hotel business closures. Work with Local Sales, * Account Sales/GSO teams to drive production from high-priority accounts, including maximizing special corporate business. Coordinate and execute property internal mining efforts for assigned hotels. Solicit new business from non-deployed small business accounts, reader boards, and internal referral leads. Identify potential new accounts or business opportunities using business intelligence from Sales & Marketing Planning and Support or third-party data sources. Utilize internal lead referral tools (*, eProspecting Portal) and ensure the hotel has a property lead generation program. Re-solicit non-deployed realized opportunities, including turndowns, lost opportunities, and actualized business. Conduct customer-facing sales activities such as solicitations, account calls, site inspections, and new business calls. Maintain complete and up-to-date lead information in CI/TY SFA Web and EMPOWER. Qualify customer's long-term business potential and refer customers to appropriate sales channels. Understand the overall market, including competitors' strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, and supply and demand. Communicate trends, opportunities, and market changes to relevant parties. Leverage all available sales channels and company marketing initiatives to optimize sales revenues. Track weekly activities and their relationship to revenue and room night production. Drive revenue from local non-deployed accounts by proactively soliciting new business and re-soliciting past leads. Activate local tactics for deployed accounts and communicate best practices for generating creative revenue opportunities. Building Relationships Leverage deployed account resources to drive business for identified properties and grow account share. Participate in community and hotel networking events (*, Rotary Clubs, Chamber of Commerce). Visit neighborhood target and local small business accounts, coordinating follow-up efforts. Coordinate with the Property Sales Leader to understand the needs and priorities of stakeholder hotels. Work collaboratively with all sales channels (*, Multi-Hotel Sales, Account Sales, Global Sales) to ensure coordinated and complementary sales efforts. Address customer care issues and refer them to the appropriate owner when necessary. Support the company’s service and relationship strategy by delivering service excellence to drive customer loyalty. Engage in property-related events that support the development of new accounts. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a relevant sales role. Demonstrated ability to drive revenue and achieve sales targets. Proficiency in utilizing sales information systems (*, CI/TY SFA Web, MRDW, MarRFP-SAPP, Hoteligence, Account Relationship Management (ARM)). Strong negotiation skills and creative selling abilities. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah. The role involves working closely with hotel General Managers, Property Sales Leaders, and various sales teams (Local Sales, * Account Sales/GSO) to ensure competitive sales strategies and market alignment. Application Process Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon inquiry. Salary for this position is not disclosed.

758050b38d65f0b6.description: About the Role Lenovo is seeking a Test Engineer – Servers to join its Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG) in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves building and managing production testing processes to ensure server functionality before deployment. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Context and Purpose The Test Engineer will be responsible for preparing, validating, and improving test processes, stations, and configurations across all stages of server manufacturing. This includes new product introduction (NPI), line qualification, pilot runs, ramp-up, and mass production. A key aspect of the role involves analyzing test failures, identifying root causes, and implementing solutions to maintain testing stability and production flow. Key Responsibilities Set up, validate, and maintain production test stations, environments, and equipment. Deploy test software and manage test code and configurations, including BIOS, BMC, and firmware versions. Analyze test failures using data, logs, and on-site observation, and resolve issues. Support server configuration testing, including OS, RAID, and network setup. Ensure correct test data uploads to the Manufacturing Execution System (MES) for full traceability. Drive improvements in test stability, yield, and efficiency. Collaborate with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, suppliers, and global Lenovo teams, providing hands-on support for urgent issues. Employee Benefits and Development Access to an international team with a focus on gender diversity. Employee Assistance Program, offering psychological, legal, and financial consultancy. Opportunity to join a company prioritizing sustainable solutions such as CO2 Offset, Asset Recovery Services, and the Lenovo Certified Refurbished portfolio. Access to training for personal development through an internal E-learning Development Platform. Participation in a mentorship program.

7542ab8133391dbb.description: About the Role HungerStation, part of the Delivery Hero Group, is seeking a Senior Product Design Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves defining and driving product design strategy, ensuring design excellence, and leading a team of Product Designers to deliver impactful customer experiences. Key Responsibilities Define and drive product design strategy aligned with HungerStation’s product and business priorities. Translate complex customer and business problems into simple, scalable experiences. Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to shape product strategy and roadmaps. Advocate for customer-centric decision-making across the organization. Identify experience gaps and opportunities across the end-to-end customer journey. Own and continuously raise the quality bar across HungerStation’s digital experiences. Provide design direction and oversight across multiple product domains. Establish clear design principles, patterns, and standards for a consistent HungerStation experience. Lead the evolution and adoption of HungerStation’s design system. Establish effective design reviews, design QA, and experience-quality processes. Ensure Design is involved early in discovery and strategic product decisions. Ensure research, customer feedback, behavioral data, usability testing, and experimentation inform design decisions. Encourage teams to validate assumptions early and continuously improve experiences after launch. Partner with Product and Data to measure design impact through conversion, engagement, adoption, retention, customer satisfaction, and usability. Ensure Design is accountable for measurable customer and business outcomes. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Research, Commercial, Marketing, and Operations. Facilitate alignment around customer problems, priorities, and solutions. Present design strategy and recommendations clearly to senior leadership. Manage conflicting priorities and influence stakeholders across multiple teams. Stay engaged through implementation to ensure the intended customer experience is delivered. Team Leadership and Development Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Product Designers. Set clear expectations around ownership, quality, collaboration, and customer impact. Develop designers’ product thinking, craft, business understanding, and stakeholder-management capabilities. Support recruitment, performance management, career development, and succession planning. Build a culture of ownership, constructive feedback, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Set performance objectives, provide necessary support, evaluate direct reports, and provide regular feedback. Participate in the identification and recruitment of key talents for the function. Provide clear direction, prioritize tasks, assign and delegate responsibility, and monitor workflow. Provide opportunities for team members to suggest, participate in, and contribute to improvement, innovation, and knowledge-sharing initiatives. Strategic Planning and Governance Contribute to the development and execution of the Division’s ABCs and OKRs, ensuring alignment with other Functions' heads. Make critical decisions that support the Division’s strategic and tactical direction. Establish plans for respective functions/teams and provide inputs that support the Division’s goals and objectives. Distribute tactical responsibilities effectively to potential leaders to improve organizational succession readiness. Measure and track relevant OKRs and metrics to ensure goal achievement and take corrective actions when necessary. Follow all relevant policies, procedures, and processes for daily work to be carried out in a controlled and consistent manner. Contribute to the identification of opportunities for continuous improvement of processes and practices. Uphold a high-performance working environment and promote HungerStation’s values. Budget Management Manage and own the budgeting cycle and provide input to the budgeting process. Ensure effective utilization of the function's budget and report accurately on progress and challenges. Investigate and propose implementing strategies that result in a positive financial impact for HungerStation. Manage reporting departments effectively within budget and report accurately on progress made and challenges encountered. Formulate strategies that result in a positive financial impact for HungerStation and aim to mitigate financial and operational risks. Qualifications and Experience 8-10 years of relevant experience in product design leadership.

75c43d580e414572.description: About the Role: Paymaster (Saudi National) SLS The Red Sea is seeking a Paymaster to join its team in Tabuk, specifically covering Umluj and Tabuk. This full-time role is crucial for ensuring accurate and timely payroll processing for team members, adhering to hotel policies and local regulations. The Paymaster will work closely with the Finance and People & Culture departments, managing sensitive information with strict confidentiality. Key Responsibilities Prepare and process monthly payroll accurately and within established timelines. Calculate and verify salaries, allowances, overtime, deductions, and other payroll adjustments. Review attendance, leave, sick leave, and other payroll-related data prior to processing. Coordinate with People & Culture and department leaders to ensure complete and accurate payroll inputs. Maintain accurate and confidential employee payroll records and system data. Review new joiners, leavers, transfers, promotions, and salary changes for correct payroll processing. Prepare payroll reports, summaries, reconciliations, and supporting documentation for month-end closing. Ensure payroll practices comply with Saudi labor regulations, company policies, and internal controls. Investigate and resolve payroll discrepancies and employee payroll queries promptly. Support Finance with payroll-related journal entries, accruals, and reconciliations. Maintain organized and audit-ready payroll documentation. Handle all employee and payroll information with strict confidentiality and professionalism. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience as a Paymaster, Payroll Officer, or in a similar role, preferably within the hospitality sector. Good knowledge of payroll processing, attendance, leave, overtime, deductions, and employee benefits. Familiarity with Saudi Labor Law and payroll-related requirements. Experience with payroll or HR systems such as Oasys, SAP, or Oracle is an advantage. Required Skills Strong numerical skills with excellent attention to detail and accuracy. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications. Ability to handle confidential employee and payroll information with discretion. Good communication and coordination skills. Ability to meet deadlines and work effectively in a fast-paced environment. Work Environment This role is based in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, covering the cities of Umluj and Tabuk. The Paymaster will operate within a dynamic hotel environment, collaborating closely with finance and human resources teams to support operational efficiency. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. The salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

75e70cbabb956844.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة Al Khozama Investment عن مسؤول عملاء وبروتوكول للانضمام إلى فريقها. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان أعلى مستويات الأمن والسلامة داخل مرافق الشركة، مع تطبيق قواعد الإتيكيت والبروتوكول الرسمي في التعامل مع كبار المسؤولين والزوار والوفود. يعكس شاغل الوظيفة الصورة المهنية والمكانة المؤسسية للشركة من خلال التزامه بالمعايير الأمنية والبروتوكولية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية التحكم ومراقبة دخول وخروج الموظفين والزوار والموردين والمتعاقدين وكبار الشخصيات. التنسيق مع إدارة الأمن والبروتوكول فيما يخص الزيارات الرسمية والاجتماعات والفعاليات. مرافقة كبار الزوار والوفود داخل مباني الشركة وضمان راحتهم وسلامتهم. القيام بجولات تفتيش دورية داخل وخارج المباني ومواقف السيارات. مراقبة أنظمة كاميرات المراقبة (CCTV) وأجهزة الإنذار والمعدات الأمنية. 75fdaa317db99bad.description: About CAMCO and the Role CAMCO – Capital Metro Company is a Saudi-French joint venture between RATP Dev and SAPTCO, responsible for the operation and maintenance of Riyadh Metro’s Blue and Red Lines. As a key player in operating one of the world’s largest fully automated metro networks, CAMCO employs over 3,000 individuals dedicated to delivering safe, reliable, and efficient metro services across Riyadh. This full-time Training Officer role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Coordinate the execution of CAMCO’s annual training calendar, ensuring timely delivery of scheduled learning activities in line with approved priorities. Manage training logistics, including room bookings, attendance records, learning materials, training vendors, and participant communication. Support the delivery of in-house and external training programs through planning, implementation follow-up, and completion monitoring. Coordinate technical training programs, certification requirements, safety-related learning activities, and capability development initiatives across operational and maintenance functions. Support the administration and tracking of competency-related training activities linked to CMS, TMS, safety-critical roles, and operational readiness requirements. Own the coordination and delivery of induction and onboarding learning programs for new joiners across CAMCO. Support employee development plans by coordinating approved learning interventions linked to performance and career growth. Liaise with line managers and SMEs to gather functional learning needs and convert them into scheduled training actions. Maintain accurate training records, attendance evidence, certificates, and learner progress within LMS/CMS/TMS systems. Monitor statutory and mandatory training completion rates and proactively escalate overdue compliance requirements. Ensure training documentation remains audit-ready, version-controlled, and accessible for HR and external reviews. Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual training dashboards covering participation, completion, budget utilization, feedback, and learning effectiveness trends. Coordinate employee development initiatives, awareness campaigns, leadership programs, technical development activities, and internal learning events as directed by the Training & Talent Manager. Support post-training evaluations, competency assessments, and learning effectiveness reviews to measure training impact and identify development opportunities. Maintain and administer Learning Management Systems (LMS), Training Management Systems (TMS), Competency Management Systems (CMS), and related learning databases to ensure data integrity and reporting accuracy. Monitor compliance with mandatory technical, operational, safety, and corporate training requirements and proactively follow up on overdue training activities. Support Knowledge Transfer and localization initiatives by coordinating development activities, training records, participant tracking, and program reporting. Coordinate cooperative training (COOP), graduate development, and trainee programs, ensuring alignment with organizational and educational institution requirements. Support ROI analysis and post-training evaluations to assess learning impact and identify improvement opportunities. Recommend improvements to learning administration, scheduling, participant experience, and reporting accuracy. Coordinate external training providers, technical institutes, universities, and certification bodies to ensure effective delivery of technical and professional development programs. Health, Safety, Quality, and Environment (HSQE) Responsibilities CAMCO emphasizes that all employees are responsible for their own health and safety, as well as the safety of others who may be affected by their work activities. To comply with these responsibilities, the Training Officer must: Apply a "Think First" approach to all tasks. Follow and apply the safety requirements outlined in CAMCO's procedures, work instructions, and risk assessments. Use safety equipment, including Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), as required and intended. Report unsafe acts and conditions, including those related to people, equipment, and workplaces. Stop and report any work believed to be unsafe. Experience Required Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in a training or learning coordination role.

75f2f95276bd0de4.description: About the Role Oceaneering is seeking a QC Coating or Welding Inspector to join our team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is responsible for performing all activities necessary to ensure ARAMCO-approved QC Welding Inspection standards are met. The role requires 0-1 years of experience. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to execute comprehensive quality control inspections related to welding activities, ensuring compliance with ARAMCO standards and project specifications. This involves detailed checks from raw material inspection through to final visual inspection and documentation. Key Responsibilities Conduct raw material inspections. Verify welding consumables against Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS). Inspect bevel angle, root gap, and face according to WPS. Check fit-up root gap and misalignment as per WPS. Monitor root pass and hot pass amperage and voltage. Perform visual inspections after completing fill and cap passes. Request client presence for visual inspections and submit corresponding reports. Initiate Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) for weld joints. Request client review of NDT films upon completion. Submit all inspection reports for client signature after film review. Authorize release for subsequent project activities. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in QC Coating or Welding Inspection. Demonstrated ability to perform inspections according to ARAMCO standards. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Saudi Arabia, contributing to Oceaneering's operational excellence in quality control. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

756a50de9c58b198.description: Department: B2C Credit, Product Location: KSA Description Tabby creates financial freedom in the way people shop, earn and save by reshaping their relationship with money. Over 25 million users choose Tabby to stay in control of their spending and make the most out of their money. The company’s flagship offering allows shoppers to split their payments online and in-store with no interest or fees. Over 70,000 global brands and small businesses, including Amazon, Noon, IKEA, and SHEIN use Tabby to accelerate growth and gain loyal customers by offering easy and flexible payments online and in stores. Tabby generates over $18 billion in annual transaction volume for its partner brands and is the highest-rated, most-reviewed, largest, and fastest-growing FinTech in the GCC region. Tabby launched in 2019 and has since raised +$1 billion in equity and debt funding from global and regional investors, and is now valued at $6,5 billion. About the role Tabby is known for BNPL, but credit is our fastest-growing business. Saudi Arabia is our biggest market, and we want to build a full consumer lending line there. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager based in Saudi Arabia to build that business from the ground up and own its P&L. This is not a feature role. You will define what the product is, how it is priced, who qualifies, how it stays compliant. What you will be doing The product construct. Define the lending products we launch in KSA and across Tabby's other markets, including eligibility, tenors, limits, repayment structure, and what happens at every edge of the flow. The P&L. Revenue and cost are yours: profit rates and pricing etc. You build the business case, commit to the numbers, and explain every month why they moved. Work with legal, compliance and external partners, and so the customer experience does not suffer for it. Billing and servicing logic. Billing logic, repayment options, early settlement, late fees, collections hand-offs. This is detailed work: you will sit with engineering and specify, case by case, what lands where and why. Strategy. Where this business should be in 12 and 24 months, which segments we serve, what we build next, and what we deliberately do not build. What you will need Saudi Arabia residency, familiarity with the market and an understanding of local culture 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager. Experience with credit or lending products matters most, but strong experience in fin-tech or tech products also works A proven track record of managing complex product lifecycles and delivering successful products Attention to detail, our products work with people's money, so precision matters at every step Comfort working with risk, compliance and legal to get a product approved, not just designed Resilience and the ability to adapt in a rapidly changing environment Fluency in English and Arabic Benefits What you can expect Ownership & Impact: A working environment that gives you autonomy and responsibility from day one. Culture: Collaborative, inclusive, and driven environment where your voice matters. Flexibility: Enjoy flexible working hours designed to optimize productivity and balance. Growth: Participate in the company’s employee stock options program and shape your career trajectory. Support: Comprehensive health insurance, generous PTO and a Flexible Benefits budget to meet your personal needs. We are passionate about creating an inclusive, high-performing workplace that gives people from all backgrounds the support they need to thrive, grow, and meet their goals (whatever they may be). Hands-on experience building applications with React . Good understanding of TypeScript and type-safe development. Good understanding of React fundamentals, including components, hooks, state management, rendering, and component lifecycle. Experience integrating frontend applications with APIs and handling asynchronous data. Familiarity with React Query / TanStack Query and Redux / Redux Toolkit . Understanding of frontend testing and experience with tools such as Jest and Playwright . Familiarity with real-time frontend architectures using WebSockets / Socket.IO . Ability to debug problems rather than only work around them. Ability to write clean, readable, and maintainable code. This Role Is a Strong Fit If You... Can take a feature from requirement to production instead of stopping when the code simply "works." Care about both speed and quality — you don't believe one has to come at the expense of the other. Use AI to multiply your productivity while still understanding and owning every solution you ship. Don't blindly copy AI-generated code — you question it, review it, test it, and improve it. Try to understand why something works, not only how to make it work. Care about code readability, scalability, and maintainability. Can receive code-review feedback and use it to improve. Communicate early when you are blocked. Enjoy collaborating and sharing knowledge with other engineers. Are curious about the product, not just the ticket assigned to you. Look for opportunities to improve existing code and engineering processes. Have a strong sense of ownership and don't need constant follow-up to get things done. Want to become a significantly stronger engineer over the next few years. What Success Looks Like Within your first months at Lucidya, we expect you to: Understand the frontend codebase, architecture, and development workflow. Debug frontend and integration issues effectively. Use AI tools to noticeably improve your development speed and productivity while maintaining engineering quality . Participate meaningfully in technical discussions and code reviews. Collaborate effectively with your squad and other engineering
